notes: Nearby Bluetooth-only Host/Join for phones without internet or Wi-Fi (pairing permissions required; radio compatibility depends on the phones). Larger game controls and boards; clearer Pool break decisions and repeatable cue-ball placement. Larger UNO cards with manual Flip/clockwise exchange and fair Slap timing. Better Solitaire hints, Draw controls and shuffle/manual finish. New illustrated Bartender orders and loading/save fixes. Jungle Snakes & Ladders, livelier Pinball with recorded metal effects, updated consistent chibi avatars, and distinct recorded victory/defeat/heart/X sounds. Performance stars reward recorded progress even on a loss. Existing online rooms, profiles, saved scores and settings are retained.
